name: Curtain open
summary: Red velvet theatre curtains with gold trim and a scalloped valance that part to reveal the scene, or close to cover it.

params.name: mode
params.note: out parts the curtains to reveal, in closes them

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: len
params.note: frames the curtains take to part or close

author: krakujs
